summary: The Generation Essentials Group (TGE) via Form 6-K announces the completion of its acquisition of a 50% interest in The Ritz-Carlton, Perth, valued at A$280 million (US$201 million) for a total consideration of US$72 million (A$100 million). The transaction closed on May 29, 2026, with no board recommendation or advisors named in the press release. TGE, a subsidiary of AMTD Digital Inc., expands its hospitality portfolio to nearly 1,000 rooms. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, corresponding to a US Form 8-K for the completion of an acquisition. What to watch: integration of the asset and potential future hospitality acquisitions by TGE.
